research_scope: Burst Rush, Super God Shock Flash, and Heroic Counter current counter-taxonomy reconciliation.

findings.name: Burst Rush
findings.finding: Retained. Current Counter Skill taxonomy explicitly lists Burst Rush as a melee counter. Current skill documentation retains PQ51 acquisition and the existing repository evidence explicitly ties the Future Warrior reward to the Ultimate Finish condition.

findings.name: Super God Shock Flash
findings.finding: Retained. Current Counter Skill taxonomy explicitly lists Super God Shock Flash as a melee counter, while current Xenoverse 2 documentation lists Skill Shop acquisition. Legacy Xenoverse PQ information is not imported into the Xenoverse 2 record.

findings.name: Heroic Counter
findings.acquisition: PQ155 — I Need a Hero... Pose!
findings.finding: Retained. Current Counter Skill taxonomy explicitly lists Heroic Counter as a universal counter. Current skill documentation identifies PQ155 and the repository's Basic Reward evidence supports false Ultimate Finish requirement.

taxonomy_note: Counter taxonomy is kept separate from canonical class/subcategory. Burst Rush and Super God Shock Flash remain Strike Supers; Heroic Counter remains a Strike Super even though its counter subtype is Universal.
